# EBU STL test files

Files made by other tools, so the reader is tested against more than the
files its own tests write:

- `irt/`: the test files of the Subtitle Conversion Framework of the
  Institut für Rundfunktechnik, as converted to binary EBU STL by Sandflow
  Consulting for ttconv (https://github.com/sandflow/ttconv). Apache License
  2.0; see `irt/LICENSE` and `irt/NOTICE`.
- `sandflow/`: test files of ttconv by Sandflow Consulting LLC. BSD 2-Clause
  License; see `sandflow/LICENSE`.
